notes_for_editor: Location conflict, not resolved. firelookout.com says four miles east of Lolo Pass (Lolo NF, Mineral County). Wikipedia's Lolo Pass (Idaho–Montana) coordinates, 46.635 N 114.580 W, put the association coordinates 47.44855, -115.61179 more than 100 km away, so the two descriptions cannot both describe the same spot. Wikipedia is a lead-grade source here; a USGS GNIS or Forest Service record would be a better citation for the Lolo Pass point. The existing Taft Summit story (data/stories/us-mt-taft-summit.md) puts a tower 7 miles ENE of Lookout Pass, and the Taft Peak coordinates are about 5 km from the Taft Summit coordinates (47.47758, -115.55235). The Lolo Pass wording may be a mix-up with Lookout Pass or the two records may overlap; no source says so. Check before publishing the location. The brief's ground kind, county and gone status match the sources. No staffing, fire, access or site-today evidence found.
